rationale: The analysis correctly identifies the rate-limit reduction, 429-triggered retries/backoff, retry-induced cache bypass, and restoration of the limit as the incident resolution. It clearly rejects cache degradation as the primary cause and maps the temporal and discriminating evidence well. Minor overreach includes assuming unchanged demand, extra downstream load, rate-limit headers, and Retry-After behavior that are not supplied in the evidence. Some proposed mitigations are sound but introduce implementation assumptions and changing cache-bypass behavior could affect unstated freshness or correctness protections.
